negative_flag.meaning: direction flag returned by Elo.ratingChange for one party after a single battle
negative_flag.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

elo_b_decreases.meaning: eloB's rating decreases as signified when negative is true
elo_b_decreases.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

elo_b_increases.meaning: eloB's rating increases as signified when negative is false
elo_b_increases.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

distorted_rankings_unfair_matchmaking_mi.meaning: severe consequences such as distorted rankings, unfair matchmaking, and mismatched rewards result from the incorrect Elo ratings
distorted_rankings_unfair_matchmaking_mi.checkpoint: after battleElo applies the inverted update and dependent protocol functionality consumes the ratings

assumptions: Elo.ratingChange(eloB, eloA, ...) computes the adjustment for eloB relative to eloA, with negative true meaning eloB should decrease.
The scenario is described conditionally; no concrete battle, actor, or observed on-chain values are supplied.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the negative true or negative false branch was actually executed in a real battle, so the concrete branch of the incident is not fixed.

The impact's downstream harms (distorted rankings, unfair matchmaking, mismatched rewards) are stated only as potential consequences conditional on dependent functionality, with no observable magnitude or relation defined.

limitations: The selected impact is formalized only as a grounded Boolean occurrence of the reported downstream consequences; no numeric ranking, matchmaking, or reward relation is defined in the report.
The eloA side of the direction requirement is not separately bound because the allowed precondition set only grounds eloB's direction semantics.
Only the negative-true branch is used as the condition; the negative-false branch is recorded in the precondition terms but not in the pattern condition.
